canonical_policy.rule: Diagnostic replay wrappers remain in processed-id coverage but are excluded from canonical current status. Among live OCR observations, the latest persisted run wins. A product is usable only when its latest live state is DECLARED and every strict OCR observation in that state agrees on the same complete calories/protein/carbohydrate/fat payload. Older DECLARED nutrition is never inherited through a later REVIEW or other non-DECLARED state.

transition_audit.policy: All 28 later REVIEW products remain unusable. The 5 explicit contradictions are safety-blocking; the other 23 are also not promoted because REVIEW is never usable.

notes: This cut supersedes earlier arithmetic counts that treated historical or diagnostic DECLARED observations as if they were current canonical usable nutrition.
Processed-id coverage and canonical nutrition usability are deliberately separate metrics.
No REVIEW row is converted into usable nutrition by this reconciliation.
